faq.a: Nayeem is associated with the Arabic form نَعِيم, whose core sense is nayeem; bliss, comfort.

faq.q: What is the origin of Nayeem?
faq.a: Nayeem is associated with Arabic. Nayeem is Arabic نَعِيم (Naʿīm), meaning 'bliss, comfort'; it occurs in the Quran.
Yes — the underlying form نَعِيم is Arabic.
Nayeem can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Nayeem should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Naʿīm occurs in the Quran as a term for bliss.

faq.q: What does Nayeem mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Nayeem is rendered نعیم and carries the sense نعیم، نعمت.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Nayeem, nayeem. Script forms are نعيم, نعیم, نَعِيم, नईम.

faq.q: Is Nayeem a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
